about: SKU Information     Stupid Never Dies: Glorious Idiot Edition         [Pre-Order Bonus]  - Up to 48 Hours of Advance Access    * Available to customers who purchase the game by October 21, 2026, 9:59 PM UTC.  * Advance Access is scheduled to begin on October 19, 2026, at 10:00 PM UTC.  * Bonus content is subject to change without prior notice.    **Items included in this bundle can also be purchased separately. Please be careful not to purchase duplicate items.    Glorious Idiot Edition set includes  - "Stupid Never Dies"  - "Stupid Never Dies" In-game item "TickTock Teddies: Nonsense Overload Pack"        Stupid Never Dies - In-game item "TickTock Teddies: Nonsense Overload Pack"         A DLC pack of TickTock Teddies usable in the base game, with exclusive special effects.   MSRP：US$11.99     - Original TickTock Teddy 1: "Big Head"       Davy gets a bobble head, and the combat music becomes a remix.  - Original TickTock Teddy 2: "Chirp Chirp"       Footstep sounds in Zombie Style get a special gimmick, and the home track becomes a remix.  - Original TickTock Teddy 3: "Festival"       Hit sounds in Davy Burst gain a special gimmick, and the Davy Burst track becomes a remix.  - Original TickTock Teddy 4: "Romantic"       The graffiti effect during Davy Burst gains a special gimmick, and the Davy Burst track becomes the theme song.  - Original TickTock Teddy 5: "Splash"       The level-up effect gains a special gimmick, and the Hurry Up track becomes a remix.    About the Game    ◾️ What Is Stupid Never Dies?     Bite, Rip, Rise!   Control Davy, the weakest zombie imaginable, and battle through a mysterious dungeon to defeat KOM, the King of Monsters.  Every dive makes Davy grow stronger faster. Customize his body, devour powerful monsters, steal their abilities, and race against time to conquer the dungeon.  Created by GPTRACK50, a studio founded by veteran action game developers, Stupid Never Dies is a unique single-player 3D action RPG combining fast-paced growth, bizarre humor, and stylish action.              ◾️ A bizarre tale of love and ruin    Davy, a timid zombie, falls in love at first sight with Julia, a college girl frozen to death during the Great War.  To bring her back to life, he must defeat KOM, recover humanity’s lost knowledge, and survive the dungeon’s deadly depths.  Can the weakest zombie save the girl he loves—and maybe the world?              ◾️ Funky zombie action       Style Eat   Defeat elite monsters, consume their cores, and steal their powers. Transform into 11 unique Styles, including Werewolf, Harpy, Golem, Vampire, and more.     Body Hack   Replace Davy’s body parts with powerful Overtech gear to boost stats and unlock new Active and Passive Skills. Fight your way with endless build combinations.     Davy Burst   Unleash Davy’s imagination to temporarily transform reality and dramatically boost all of his abilities.                ◾️ Overtech monsters    Battle classic monsters enhanced by Overtech, including werewolves, vampires, harpies, lizardmen, and more.  Different weapons, armor, and abilities make every encounter fresh and unpredictable.      ◾️ Main Characters           Davy  The weakest zombie in existence. Mocked by monsters and humans alike, he enters the dungeon to save Julia and prove himself.    Julia  A college student who died inside a shopping mall freezer during the Great War. Davy falls in love the moment he finds her.    Dr. Frank  A brilliant but obsessive scientist who guides Davy’s journey while pursuing his own ambitions.
